messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(3 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. The main one is that a down notification for a single peer NI now cancels discovery for the whole peer, which changes behaviour for multi-rail peers whose discovery is in flight over a healthy net. It would also help to add a regression test (e.g. a sanity-lnet case using a drop rule on the discovery GET plus a peer-down notification) so the new cancellation path gets regular coverage.

commit.subject: LU-20626 lnet: cancel discovery on peer down
commit.message:
LU-20626 lnet: cancel discovery on peer down

An LND peer-down notification can arrive after a discovery GET has
completed its send event. The MD then remains PING_SENT until
response expiry, preventing prompt rediscovery after a connection
reset.

When an LND reports the peer down, retain the peer reference while
dropping lnet_net_lock and unlink the discovery MD. The existing
unlink handler marks discovery failed and permits rediscovery.

Tested with an OST HA failover after a SockLND TCP reset.

Signed-off-by: Aboo Valappil <vadakkumuri.valappil.abooback@oracle.com>
Change-Id: I5e5d434895f4b3ec0f7fc520b25b0ddf8fca0ea0
